The maps <MATH_0001> and <MATH_0002> come from an application of

and the other two maps come from

(and the fact that <MATH_0003> lives over <MATH_0004>).
To show the <MATH_0005>-fibre product property, it suffices to prove the lemma
for the diagram

of categories fibred in groupoids, see

<REF_0003>.
In other words, it suffices to show that an object of the <MATH_0007>-fibre product

to a <MATH_0010>-valued point of <MATH_0011> and similarly for morphisms. And of course
this is exactly how we constructed <MATH_0012> and <MATH_0013> in the first place.

<MATH_0049>. Hence the arrow
